title: Immersive Measuremets
description: Adds devices for Measurement position, time and speed
body:
🧭 Immersive Measurements

Immersive Measurements is a vanilla-plus utility mod that bridges the gap between total immersion and technical data. Tired of staring at the cluttered F3 debug screen? This mod introduces a suite of handheld instruments that provide real-time data about your environment, movement, and position through actual gameplay items.

Whether you are optimizing a diamond mine, testing the speed of your new horse, or navigating the deep sea, these tools offer a clean and immersive way to stay informed.

🛠️ The Toolkit
- Depthmeter: Precision tracking for your verticality. Displays your exact Y-level, making it the perfect companion for miners and cave explorers.
- Triangulator: A specialized tool for horizontal navigation. It provides your X and Z coordinates, allowing you to map out the world without the "cheat" feel of the debug menu.
- Digital Clock: A modern take on timekeeping. View the precise day-time at a glance to ensure you’re never caught outside after dark.
- GPS: The pinnacle of navigation technology. The GPS combines the power of all the above tools, displaying full coordinates (X, Y, Z) and the time in one unified interface.
- Speedometer: Ever wondered how fast your Elytra or Blue Ice road actually is? This tool measures your current velocity in blocks per second.
- Radar: With this device, you won't have any questions about how many chickens are in your coop or whether there are any living villagers in the village, and the enemy won't be able to sneak up behind you!

🌟 Why Immersive Measurements?
No More F3 Spams: Keep your screen clean and play the game the way it was meant to be played.
Roleplay Friendly: Perfect for modpacks focused on realism, exploration, or steampunk themes.
Lightweight & Efficient: Designed to be a seamless addition to any Minecraft version with minimal performance impact.
VR-Friendly: Use it with ViveCraft!
